items.title: Ingrid Sertso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: I have to sing 'Laura,' I have to sing the common standards you know.

ctx.x: Can you give me a couple of examples?

It will be “My Funny Valentine,” “Look for the Silver Lining,” I made a whole list of them. It’s difficult. Because some songs have incredible melody and stupid lyrics. So if the writer of the lyrics is old enough, or is already dead for a long time, then I can change it. So I love the song “You Don’t Know What Love Is” which has relative good lyrics so I’m definitely going to do that one, then “What a Wonderful World.” I love the songs, and it comes out of my experience out of my studies, the songs that can…
I would love to have one.
